segments.name: Office/Industrial Properties
segments.description: Office and industrial properties leased to commercial tenants on multi-tenant leases, generating rental and recovery revenue.
segments.evidence: The Company acquires and operates income producing properties in three business segments including Office/Industrial Properties, Model Home Properties and Retail Properties.

segments.name: Model Home Properties
segments.description: Model homes bought from homebuilders and leased back to them on triple-net leases for their residential marketing.
segments.evidence: Our Model Home Properties are leased back, on a triple-net basis, to homebuilders.

segments.name: Retail Properties
segments.description: Retail property held for rental income from its commercial tenant.
segments.evidence: The Company acquires and operates income producing properties in three business segments including Office/Industrial Properties, Model Home Properties and Retail Properties.

revenueModel.text: Commercial tenants pay rent and recoveries on office, industrial and retail leases; homebuilders pay triple-net rent on leased-back model homes.
revenueModel.evidence: For the Model Home segment, the properties are leased on a triple net basis and the tenants are responsible for a significant portion of the operating expenses.
